preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The lower bound l and upper bound r must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000, with l less than or equal to r.

preconditions.expression: all(l <= a[i] <= r for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of sequence a must be within the range [l, r].
The lengths of sequences a and p must both be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of the compressed sequence p must be distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(b) else True
postconditions.description: If no suitable sequence b exists, output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(c[i] == b[i] - a[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The sequence c must be correctly calculated as the difference between b and a.
The compressed sequence p must contain all integers from 1 to n.
